---
description: Review a completed feature against acceptance criteria and evidence.
agent: feature-delivery
---

Review the current diff as a skeptical maintainer.

For each Given/When/Then criterion, cite the implementation and test that prove it.
Check validation semantics, rate-limit window behavior, Retry-After, decimal arithmetic,
scope creep, and missing evidence. Re-run focused tests when a claim is uncertain.
Report only actionable findings; do not change files.
